tagline: Building scalable, high-performance web applications with .NET Core & React.
description: Full Stack Developer specializing in .NET Core Web API, React/React Native, AWS cloud provisioning, and AI-powered video analytics.
bio: Results-driven Full Stack Developer with 3 years of experience building scalable, high-performance web and mobile applications using .NET Core Web API and React/React Native. Proven expertise in end-to-end product delivery — from RESTful API design and database optimization to responsive UI development, cloud deployments on AWS, and containerization with Docker. Adept at Agile/SCRUM environments with a strong focus on code quality, TDD, and CI/CD. Demonstrated success migrating legacy codebases, building AI-powered SaaS products, and delivering business-critical features across healthcare and media domains.

bullets: Diagnosed and resolved client-reported issues efficiently, maintaining system reliability and developed AWS EC2/S3 bucket provisioning forms via Terraform.
Successfully migrated legacy AngularJS codebase to React with TypeScript, improving application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Worked on seamless integration of audits, policy management, training, and reporting modules, ensuring a unified platform experience.
Implemented role-based authentication and authorization (RBAC) using JWT, securing access control and protecting sensitive healthcare data.
Optimized API performance and MSSQL queries by refining stored procedures and indexing strategies, reducing response times under high loads.
experience.desc: Developed care management features, migrated AngularJS to React, provisioned AWS resources using Terraform, and optimized MSSQL database performance with JWT RBAC implementation.
